# Animated Weapons dependency

Source: https://www.nexusmods.com/gta4/mods/641

Bundled model archive: the tested Animated Weapons Vanilla Fusion Overloader
`weapons.img`, supplied from `KxE4Yj3c_AnimatedWeaponsVanilla.7z`.
The external weapon-animation ASIs are not included; GTA4VR implements its own
tracked weapon interaction and native animation handling.

Credits: ImpossibleEchoes / shvab (script), Spartan112 / Sierra112 (models and
animations), Rockstar (original weapons and animations). The mod page also credits
AstoSolen (animation fixer) and KryzS (alternative models).
The supplied archive's original readme is preserved alongside this notice.

The Nexus permissions, checked 2026-10-11, allow redistribution, modification and
asset use with creator credit. Selling mods containing these assets is prohibited;
earning Nexus Donation Points requires the author's permission. These assets do
not become GPL-licensed by inclusion in GTA4VR. Preserve these notices on reuse.

This tested archive is not asserted to be byte-identical to every download
currently offered on the source page.
